items.title: Independent AI & Biotech Consultant
items.subtitle: Scoping, architecture and implementation
details: Selected engagements are listed below. Work spans production AI, scientific computing and technical strategy.

Viaduct.ai: developed an interpretable truck-failure detection algorithm. Phystech Ventures: technical due diligence of biotech ML methods. Drone Solutions: computer-vision department strategy supporting a $300,000 fundraise.

items.title: Lead AI Engineer & Architect
items.subtitle: Production LLM systems · via a consultancy · under NDA
details: Led architecture and most implementation of multilingual production AI systems, then hired a small engineering team. All data storage and AI processing remained in the EU.
Board intelligence: SharePoint documents and recordings become source-checked agenda briefs, decision timelines, follow-up tracking and cited Q&A with hybrid search.

News intelligence: took over an early prototype and developed it with a hired engineer. Nightly monitoring in 16 languages, event deduplication, source ratings, executive briefs, cited chat and a risk register linked to evidence.

Document automation: translated scanned technical drawings while preserving stamps and signatures; generated manufacturing certificates from 1C ERP data. Delivered workflows through Teams with SharePoint / OneDrive sync.
Python, FastAPI, Pydantic AI, LiteLLM, PostgreSQL / pgvector, React, TypeScript, Microsoft Graph / Entra ID, Docker, GCP and Azure.

items.title: Contractor — Altos Labs
items.subtitle: Single-cell and spatial genomics for cell therapy
details: Analysed scRNA-seq and 10x Xenium data for cell-therapy development; developed quality-control metrics for spatial transcriptomics.
Built benchmarks quantifying the impact of cell-segmentation errors. Co-first author of the resulting Nature Genetics paper (2026).

items.title: Consultant — Stealth Biotech Start-up
items.subtitle: CAR-T cell-therapy development
details: Built automated scRNA-seq, CITE-seq, TCR/BCR-seq and ATAC-seq analysis pipelines and wrote analysis and interpretation guidelines.
Python, R, Snakemake, Scanpy and Seurat.

items.title: Team Lead, Data Science — Cleverbots
items.subtitle: Data-science consulting
details: Built matchmaking and event recommendations deployed at a week-long event with 1,000+ participants.
Built a market-share prediction model and managed developers on a churn-prediction project.
Bayesian sales forecasting, personalised pharmacy offers, and factory-process modelling and optimisation.

items.title: Algorithm Developer — EPAM Systems
items.subtitle: Pharmaceutical and genomics algorithms
details: OpGen: de novo genome assembly and structural-variant detection from optical maps (Perl, Python, C++).
Novartis: extended dose–response curve fitting with additional curve parameters (Java, R).
Merck: reimplemented drug-effect trend analysis for a new experiment-management system (SAS, R).

items.title: Co-founder — Bio-waste Venture
items.subtitle: Paused
items.place: Fifty Years 5050 accelerator · London / West Africa
details: Assessed biological processing of fish waste into fertiliser and feed ingredients, researched markets and buyers, and conducted stakeholder interviews in Ghana.
Paused after the accelerator when fish waste proved to have a cheap existing outlet as pig feed.

items.title: Solo Founder — LabMap
items.subtitle: Search engine and map of academic labs
details: Built the full product: LLM-based data collection and annotation, search, interactive map, backend and web interface. Ran promotion and tracked user feedback.
Python, TypeScript, Next.js, React, Gemini, OpenAI API, LiteLLM, OpenAlex, BigQuery, Meilisearch / Typesense and GCP.

items.title: Co-founder — Cell-perturbation Start-up
items.subtitle: Cancelled
details: Conducted market analysis, developed strategy and built technical prototypes for predicting cellular responses to perturbations.
Cancelled after assessing model performance and the competitive landscape.

items.title: CTO — Tentakel
items.subtitle: LLM applications for businesses
details: Hired and managed three developers. Built a natural-language-to-SQL and visualisation MVP and a RAG product over gigabytes of documents.
Defined technical strategy and product requirements with clients; contributed to market research, business-model analysis and fundraising.

items.title: Co-founder & Data Scientist — SEADS
items.subtitle: Data-science consulting for non-profits
details: Family Empowerment Media: Hausa interview transcription and analysis, ASR benchmarking, Whisper / XLS-R fine-tuning and publication of the BibleTTS Hausa dataset.
Centre for Effective Altruism: conference survey analysis. TalkItOver: chatbot impact and conversation analysis. Fish Welfare Initiative: water-quality analysis.
Additional work included charity-choice research, EA Forum analytics, influencer networks and alternative-protein job-market analysis for Talist.

items.title: PhD, Biostatistics and Bioinformatics
items.place: University of Copenhagen · research at Harvard Medical School
details: Thesis: Case-control analysis of single-cell RNA-seq studies.
Supervisors: Konstantin Khodosevich (University of Copenhagen) and Peter Kharchenko (Harvard Medical School).

items.title: Master, Applied Informatics and Computer Science
details: Thesis: Accurate estimation of molecular counts in droplet-based single-cell RNA-seq experiments.
Additional study: Computer Science Center, Data Analysis track; HST Summer Institute, Harvard Medical School (2016).

items.title: Bachelor, Applied Mathematics and Computer Science
details: Thesis: Fast deskewing of text document images.

items.title: Product Management and Product Strategy
details: Additional training in product management and product strategy.
